evidence_items.explanation: This is a recorded model response, not the researchers' proposed solution. The paper describes the proposed transfer mechanisms as physically unsound, but this earlier, different task does not establish persistence of the specified 2020 failures during the target period.

This original report found substantial success on selected false-belief tasks. Those tasks do not establish resolution of the authors' particular failures, but the result cautions against reading the claim as an absence of psychological reasoning successes.
